metadata.title: Group 42 Executed Test Case Catalogue
metadata.scope: The 140 additional functional and outage checks from acceptance pack v3.4.
metadata.test_design: Authored regression inputs and project/corpus-derived expectations. Original-language inputs are preserved.
metadata.intent_suite_rule: Accuracy >=95%, with every model and vector channel successful. 59/60 meets the suite threshold; XI20 is still a failed case.
metadata.knowledge_suite_rule: Every case must satisfy expected status, method, source, required patterns, quotation integrity and no-degradation contract.
metadata.reply_suite_rule: Every declared check, exact quote and real model channel must pass.
